Company Description

Marlabs Inc (www.marlabs.com) is a US based global technology services and Solutions Company with a presence in North America, South America, Europe and Asia providing avant-garde services to Fortune companies. As a Gold partner with Microsoft, Oracle and a Premier business partner of IBM and all leading technology companies, Marlabs is in the hall of fame of Inc500 and, as well as being ranked by Deloitte and Touche as one of the fastest growing companies, we were recently chosen as One of the 50 Best Places to work in NJ, among large employers. Marlabs owns technology Center of Excellence (CoE) in the US to help employees in continued learning and innovation with cutting edge technologies and solutions to consistently stay at the forefront of the technology wave.

Marlabs provides solutions to over 100 customers, Including Fortune 500, from North America, South America, Europe and Asia in Banking/Finance, Media, Insurance, Retail and Energy & Utilities verticals. Company has major delivery centers in the US, Nearshore centers in Canada, Mexico and Offshore delivery centers in India and Malaysia.

We welcome candidates nationwide who are Citizens, Permanent Residents and International students who would qualify to work in the E-Verify program.

For more visit www.marlabscampus.com

Industries Served:

Healthcare, BFSI, Airline Services, Energy and Utilities, Education, Retail, Media and Government

Technology Solutions:

Cloud, Mobility, BI-Analytics, Microsoft, Java, Open Source, Infrastructure Security and CRM

Services:

Application Development and Maintenance, Information Security, Infrastructure Services, Testing, Packaged Implementation & Support, Product Engineering.

Mentorship program in Marlabs is one of the best in the industry and executive management members also invest their time directly to train and mentor our team members, which is unique. Excellent growth opportunity and career advancement options are provided for dedicated employees. Company recognizes top performing employees every month and at end of each year.

Job Description

Number of Current Opportunities: 45

Campus 1: Bethlehem, PA

Campus 2: Piscataway, NJ immediately

We, a fast-growing Global Information Technology Solutions company, hires over 100 fresh engineering graduates every year from reputed engineering and management schools nationwide. At this time, we are hiring for 45 Entry level positions at Technology Center of Excellence (CoE) in:

Application / Database Development

Web/ Mobile development

ERP/ CRM

Job Responsibilities:

Develop and support custom applications

Coding fixes and new software development

Managing and supporting production and test systems

Participating in occasional after hours / weekend support and / or deployments

Must be willing to learn new/ updated technologies

Selected candidates will be trained on-the-job and absorbed in to our technology practice areas in Microsoft (.NET, Sharepoint, Biztalk, Dynamics CRM ,Axapta - AX), JAVA, Websphere Commerce Server , Front development using HTML5 CSS3 and JavaScript.

Qualifications

Desired Skills & Experience

Strong knowledge on Object Oriented Programming concepts

Strong knowledge on Database concepts

Basic programming knowledge on any programming language/s e.g. C/ C++/Java/.Net/ Open source/ Databases/ ERP / CRM

Knowledge on Mobile development environment - iOS / Android

Excellent communication skills

Educational qualifications:

Master's Degree or Bachelor's degree in Computers Science, Engineering or MIS OR MBA OR

Bachelors in computer science engineering.

Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
